sql_query.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM _care_recipient WHERE primaryCaregiverId = $1 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM _medication m JOIN _care_recipient cr ON m.careRecipientId = cr.id WHERE cr.primaryCaregiverId = $1 AND m.active = true

SELECT a.*, cr.firstName as recipientFirstName, cr.lastName as recipientLastName FROM _appointment a JOIN _care_recipient cr ON a.careRecipientId = cr.id WHERE cr.primaryCaregiverId = $1 AND a.dateTime >= NOW() AND a.dateTime <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' AND a.completed = false ORDER BY a.dateTime ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.*, cr.firstName as recipientFirstName, cr.lastName as recipientLastName FROM _care_task t JOIN _care_recipient cr ON t.careRecipientId = cr.id WHERE cr.primaryCaregiverId = $1 AND t.status != 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY t.createdAt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.dosage, m.unit, m.timeOfDay, cr.firstName as recipientFirstName, cr.lastName as recipientLastName FROM _medication m JOIN _care_recipient cr ON m.careRecipientId = cr.id WHERE cr.primaryCaregiverId = $1 AND m.active = true
